WITH kept AS (
  SELECT r.name AS race_name, ds.points AS points
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  WHERE ds.points > 1.0
), per_name AS (
  SELECT race_name, AVG(points) AS avg_points
  FROM kept
  GROUP BY race_name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_points) AS overall_avg
  FROM per_name
)
SELECT p.race_name, p.avg_points, p.avg_points - o.overall_avg AS difference
FROM per_name AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE p.avg_points > o.overall_avg;
